title: UAP-class objects coming down from the outer atmosphere south of Picatinny
place_text: Airspace south of Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey

tellings.quote: And we had UAP class stuff popping up to the south of there, coming in from the outer atmosphere and hovering into place and going back into space.

plain: In 2024, objects he calls "UAP class" (UAP is the government's term for unidentified anomalous phenomena, meaning UFOs) appeared south of Picatinny Arsenal, a US military site in New Jersey. According to Jake Barber, a man who says he once used his helicopter to retrieve a UFO, they came in from the outer atmosphere, hovered into place, and then went back into space. He tells it as something he and his team saw, and if true it would mean craft were moving freely between space and the skies over New Jersey.
